_schema: Hero banter lines — short personality dialogue triggered at battle events. Keyed by hero_id, then event_key. Unmapped hero × event returns empty silently.
_events: battle_start — fired once per player chibi hero at battle init
player_kill — fired on the unit that landed killing blow (player side only)
low_hp — fired on the unit that dropped below ~30% HP
outcome_win — fired on each surviving player chibi hero at battle WIN
outcome_loss — fired on each player chibi hero at battle LOSS
_authoring_notes: Korean. Single short sentence per line (≤20 chars optimal). Voice contrast required across heroes — see character spec docs (design/art/characters/*.md) for personality anchors.
